answer: A farm of 209 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in dune, queued in ledge, and falcon publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 68 identities per epoch. A farm of 871 identities would post 3173 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
